manifest.name: number-input
manifest.title: NumberInput
manifest.description: A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and three density-aware sizes.
manifest.usage: Use NumberInput for a number the user types or nudges: a port, a pool size, a timeout. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value (a number, or null when empty), onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Set min, max and step, and format (Intl.NumberFormat options) for units or percentages; the value stays a plain number. Arrow keys step, Shift+arrow or PageUp/PageDown take largeStep. For a value in a range where the exact number matters less, use Slider; for identifiers that only look like numbers (an account number, a ZIP code), use Input.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change, typing or stepping.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when a change is committed (blur, a step, Enter).

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value; stepping and blur clamp to it.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is shown (unit, percent, fraction digits).

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for formatting and parsing; defaults to the user's.

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description: Keeps a typed value outside min and max instead of clamping it on blur.

props.name: size
props.description: Height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: Must have a value before the form submits.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: group
slots.description: The frame around the input and the buttons; data-slot="number-input-group".

slots.name: input
slots.description: The text control, inputmode decimal, tabular figures; data-slot="number-input-input".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a step button: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus in the input: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field: the frame's border is color.status.danger.border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction; the frame dims to opacity.disabled.

states.name: at-limit
states.description: A step button at min or max is disabled and shows color.fg.disabled.

accessibility: The text control is an <input> with inputmode="decimal" (Base UI); inside a Field it takes the label, description and aria-invalid. Without a Field, give it an aria-label.
Arrow Up and Down change the value by step, Shift+arrow and PageUp/PageDown by largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max.
The step buttons are named Decrease and Increase and stay out of the tab order (the keyboard already steps); they disable at the limits.
A formatted value ("30 seconds") is read as shown; the form submits the plain number.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
